hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that implements 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swaps by intercepting beforeSwap: it takes the input token from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert it, then settles the output — bypassing the AMM entirely. Liquidity addition is blocked; only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee can use this hook.
